oracle_authority: Evaluator-only visible-state specification derived from the unchanged frozen author materials before any R1 learner output was read. Existing fixture-only audit evidence corroborated the raw mapping. No outcome labels or hidden rule selectors are supplied.
scope: Evaluator-supplied visible-state diagnosis after the first reserved assessment is preserved. No outcome labels or hidden rule selectors enter this control.
Raw script node targets and literal primitive arguments are checked against the original frozen action payloads. Raw pre-state fields are assessed separately from emitted-response accuracy.

The request identity is absent from the terminal visible page. Its raw name anchor is optional for aggregate visible-state fidelity and remains unavailable for exact-name owner, entity and dependent field corroboration. The control must not invent a terminal identity anchor or interpret this limitation alone as learner failure.

The final action has no literal scalar argument. All evaluation scripted primitives are clicks: argument matches certify primitive custody and absence of stray text; they do not establish learned typed-argument semantics. Earlier type effects in the published initial trace were audited separately using preserved fixture-only evidence.

Visible entity names are exact and case-sensitive; no context, token, spelling or key normalization is applied. Entity membership requires a uniquely named nonpositional object and a raw descendant source anchor.
Numeric whole fields allow an exact unit suffix for value fidelity. A unit-bearing text field does not establish availability as a scalar numeric operand.

Optional trajectory alignment uses at least two distinct oracle pre-state values with no present-value disagreements, after preservation, without outcomes. It is supplied diagnostic correspondence, not inferred field semantics. Missing rows remain unavailable.

Constant review fields cannot qualify by numerical coincidence. Field-source node provenance is absent from saved scorer attribute records; missing explicit labels or unique alignment remain unavailable.
The review operands belong to the selected resource. Both reviewed worlds have the same observable results, so this control makes no claim to identify the hidden review mechanism.

The retained exact-name and explicit-reference utilities define a limited diagnostic surface. Alternate unnamed, containment-based or view-based representations can remain unavailable without being disproved.
No new application cases, collector behavior, learner representation, parser, fit, score, model output or first reserved result was inspected or modified to prepare this specification.
